methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing collected from each provider's own pricing page on 2026-06-13 (corroborating sources noted where the vendor page rendered non-USD or did not expose prices to the fetcher). All figures are monthly USD; where a vendor lists both monthly and annual billing the monthly-billed price is used as monthlyUsd and the annual discount is captured in annualDiscountPct. Quote-only / custom-priced tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null. Minutes/calls/overage fields are not applicable to this software vertical and are null throughout.

enrichment.provenance: squareup.com/us/en/legal/general/hipaa fetched 2026-06-15: Square's HIPAA BAA applies only to Services where Square acts as a Business Associate (e.g. Appointments, Invoices).
